2086|4eb20e0f.name: Valstag Ironjaw
2086|4eb20e0f.text: It takes strong arms and brave hearts to keep the town of Menethil safe!

246752|21834042.name: Arcanist Ginsberg
246752|21834042.text:
Unfortunately the rumor of our plight is true. Disruptions to our ley lines have unveiled a disturbance amongst the arcane forces of our city.

With Dalaran on the cusp of reopening its borders to our allies, we are in dire need of immediate solutions.

246848|93d3f9d1.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|93d3f9d1.text: Greetings $N. Welcome to the kingdom of Dalaran. There are restrictions in place while the city remains under construction. If you have important matters that must be presented to the Kirin Tor you may speak with Arcanist Ginsberg in the overlook to the east.

246848|ae06472b.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|ae06472b.text:
It is still under construction and only a short walk up the northeast road. The Alterac mountains have brought unneeded attention from some wild creatures and our recent interest in Silverpine Forest has kept our patrols quite busy.

Some small rumors have even spread about a juvenile drake soaring over the mountains with a full eye.

2543|41cbc7e1.name: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver
2543|41cbc7e1.text: Take care while in our city, $c. We are ever wary of strangers since the city was destroyed, and any untoward behavior while within this place will not be tolerated.

1275-progress.name: Gershala Nightwhisper
1275-progress.text:
Once I have enough samples to study, my true work can begin. With the corrupted brain stems of both the satyr and naga of Blackfathom Deeps I can try to draw a correlation between the mutations.

Perhaps with that gained knowledge we can prevent the blood elves from delving deeper into deformity and evil.
1275-progress.title: Researching the Corruption

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

167-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-progress.text: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
167-progress.title: Oh Brother...

168-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
168-progress.title: Collecting Memories

3370-progress.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
3370-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3370-progress.title: In Nightmares

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

78124-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78124-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78124-complete.title: Nar'thalas Almanac

78124-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78124-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78124-progress.title: Nar'thalas Almanac

78145-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78145-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78145-complete.title: Arcanic Systems Manual

78145-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78145-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78145-progress.title: Arcanic Systems Manual

79097-complete.name: Garion Wendell
79097-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79097-complete.title: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics

79097-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79097-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79097-progress.title: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics

91904-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92415-accept.name: Unknown
92415-accept.text: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>
92415-accept.title: Remember That I Love You

92415-complete.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
92415-complete.text:
Heartweaver? Heartweaver...

Oh! Little Jeremy Heartweaver. He was brought in years ago after the attack on Lordaeron. Lost both of his parents in the attack, poor thing.

He was actually adopted not too long ago by a sweet woman out in Duskwood.
92415-complete.title: Remember That I Love You

92415-progress.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
92415-progress.text: What is it, $N? What are you looking for?
92415-progress.title: Remember That I Love You

95161-accept.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
95161-accept.text:
If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.

If you see little Jeremy do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
95161-accept.title: Remember That I Love You

95189-accept.name: Unknown
95189-accept.text: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95189-accept.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95189-complete.name: Lady Dena Kennedy
95189-complete.text:
How in the world did you find this? It's in such remarkable condition... all things considered.

Thank you for restoring this piece of Alliance history, $c. I'll have my best people get to work restoring this immediately.
95189-complete.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95189-progress.name: Lady Dena Kennedy
95189-progress.text: Welcome to the gallery. Feel free to browse.
95189-progress.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95195-accept.name: Unknown
95195-accept.text: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>
95195-accept.title: Bloodied Insignia

95195-complete.name: General Marcus Jonathan
95195-complete.text:
Your instincts to bring these to me were not unfounded. When Lordaeron fell to the scourge, many people fled to take refuge here in Stormwind. There are likely few who remain to claim these insignias themselves.

Your duty to Stormwind is commended, $N. I'll begin distributing these tokens to next of kin right away.
95195-complete.title: Bloodied Insignia

95195-progress.name: General Marcus Jonathan
95195-progress.text: You look as if you're carrying a heavy burden, $N. What is it?
95195-progress.title: Bloodied Insignia

95250-accept.name: Unknown
95250-accept.text:
Ah, a fellow $r. It's about time Lordaeron sent reinforcements.

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I don't dare trust this task to any of these filthy half breeds, but if I could impose on you a favor, I beg of you to find me the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
95250-accept.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-complete.name: Unknown
95250-complete.text:
<Truman looks at the head of his former lord in horror and disgust.>

Is this... some kind of joke? Why would you bring me this monstrosity's head?

Get out of my sight! I should have known better than to trust someone who allies themselves with the type of filth you do. The true sons of Lordaeron will reclaim our home. And when we do we'll finally be free to purge it of beasts and those who consort with them like you!
95250-complete.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-progress.name: Unknown
95250-progress.text: Good to see you're still alive and kicking! How fares the battle? Have you seen my lord?
95250-progress.title: Abominable Creatures

97005-accept.name: Bainham
97005-accept.text:
There's rumors of a monstrous abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say its so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me it's head.
97005-accept.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97914-complete.name: Baros Alexston
97914-complete.text: <Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.>
97914-complete.title: Expanding Horizons

97914-progress.name: Baros Alexston
97914-progress.text:
I can smell the sea on you, friend!

<Baros laughs.>

What brings you to Stormwind?
97914-progress.title: Expanding Horizons

97926-accept.name: Baros Alexston
97926-accept.text:
I wish it was that easy to help, $c. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926-accept.title: Making Do

97926-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-complete.text:
Sad news indeed. Still, I thank you for making the journey.

With neither Stormwind nor Darnassus coming to aid us, it seems that Auberdine's fate is our own to decide.
97926-complete.title: Making Do

97926-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-progress.text: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?
97926-progress.title: Making Do

98197-accept.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-accept.text:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197-accept.title: Spoils of War

98461-complete.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
98461-complete.text:
<Tarrel reads the note.>

Oh... oh my. Poor Hollee.

She always did have a bit of a thing for me. And, truth be told, there was a time where I would have reciprocated. But I'm married. Happily married!

I think the best thing to do here is not to reply. I don't know how to let her down, and I have far more pressing things to worry about here! My wife is missing!
98461-complete.title: Unrequited Love
